toast.lost: The connection dropped before TierPlan answered the request to {{verb}} {{name}}. The list shows whether it happened.
toast.lostMany: The connection dropped before TierPlan answered the request to {{verb}} {{count}} containers. The list shows what happened.

stop.title: Stop {{name}}?
stop.body: It gets {{seconds}} seconds to shut down before Docker kills it, using the container's own stop settings.
stop.bodyOwn: Docker asks it to shut down first and kills it if it takes too long, using the container's own stop settings.
stop.bodyBulk: Each one uses its own stop settings.

refusal.own_container: {{name}} is one of TierPlan's own containers. Stopping it would cut TierPlan off from the host, so it can't be done from this list.
refusal.node_unreachable: {{node}} isn't reachable right now. Try again when it's back.
refusal.not_found: {{name}} no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
refusal.agent_policy_denied: This host's agent needs an update
refusal.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
refusal.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.
refusal.lost: The connection dropped before TierPlan answered. The list shows whether it happened.
refusal.confirmation: Type the container's name to confirm this.
refusal.host_read_only: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so TierPlan can only read from it.
refusal.container_running: {{name}} is running. Tick Force to remove it.

agentUpdate.title: This host's agent needs an update
agentUpdate.lead: It's too old to do this.
agentUpdate.update: Update it in Settings → Environments → {{environment}}, then try again.
agentUpdate.ask: Ask an administrator to update it.

actions.readOnlyHost: This host is read-only (set on the host)

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.none: None of the selected containers can be {{verb}}.

select.own: TierPlan's own containers can't be part of a bulk action.

kill.title: Kill {{name}}?
kill.body: Sends SIGKILL now. The process gets no chance to shut down cleanly, and data it was writing can be lost.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: The container is deleted. Its image and its named volumes stay.
remove.forceHelp: Needed to remove a running container.
remove.volumesHelp: Volumes Docker made for this container without a name. Named volumes are never removed.
remove.forceRequired: Tick Force to remove a running container.

restart.title: Restart {{name}}?
restart.body: Docker stops it and starts it again.

pause.title: Pause {{name}}?
pause.body: Everything in it freezes until it is unpaused.

advanced.help: Leave empty to use the container's own settings.
advanced.timeoutInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds, 0 to 86400.
advanced.signalInvalid: Use letters and digits, up to 16, such as SIGTERM.

warn.task: This is a task of service {{service}}. Swarm will replace it. To stop it for good, scale the service.
warn.tasks_one: {{count}} of these is a task of a swarm service. Swarm will replace it.
warn.tasks_other: {{count}} of these are tasks of swarm services. Swarm will replace them.
warn.project: Part of project {{project}}. The next deploy will recreate it.
warn.projects_one: {{count}} of these belongs to a project. The next deploy will recreate it.
warn.projects_other: {{count}} of these belong to projects. The next deploy will recreate them.

own.server: This is TierPlan's own container. {{gerund}} it cuts TierPlan off from this host, and you can't start it again from here.
own.agent: This is the TierPlan agent on {{node}}. {{gerund}} it cuts TierPlan off from {{node}}.
